data.one_liner: A customizable set of expansion tiles with styling, animations, and expansion control options.
data.what_it_does: The expansion_tile_list package provides a container widget for managing a list of ExpansionTile or ExpansionTileItem widgets. It supports various expansion behaviors (accordion modes), custom separators, global trailing animations, programmatic control via controllers, and reordering.
use_when: You need to display a list of expandable tiles with advanced control over expansion modes.
You require customizable gaps, separators, and global animations across multiple expansion tiles.
You want to programmatically control tile expansion or reorder items in an expandable list.
avoid_when: You only need a single standard Flutter ExpansionTile without extra list management features.
You require complex virtualized data grids or heavy custom scrolling architectures not covered by standard lists.
strengths: Multiple built-in expansion modes like atMostOne, atLeastOne, exactlyOne, and any.
Support for custom item builders, separators, gap sizing, and trailing animations.
Includes drag-and-drop reordering and programmatic controllers.
weaknesses: Limited to expansion tile lists and related UI styling patterns.
Relies on standard Flutter widget trees for layout.
